questions_and_answers.question_text: Which verb is used in expressing the distance between two points?
How may approximate numbers be expressed?
From which number may -duō be used with any round number?
With which round numbers may -jǐ be used instead of -duō?
With the number 10, which suffix is used, and which is never used?
Where is -duō added in a number phrase?

answers.answer_text: Immediately after the number, before the counter.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "more than 200 kilometers."
Write the Chinese for "more than 10 dollars."
Write the Chinese for "Tiānjīn is 120 kilometers from Běijīng."

answers.answer_text: Tiānjīn lí Běijīng yǒu yìbǎi'èrshí gōnglǐ.
No — it is one of the nouns used without a counter.

articles.text:
2. A: Shànghǎi lí Nánjīng yǒu duō    How far is Shànghǎi from Nánjīng?
      yuǎn?
   B: Yǒu liǎngbǎiwǔshiduō gōnglǐ.   It's over 250 kilometers.

Notes on No. 2

Shànghǎi lí Nánjīng yǒu duō yuǎn? Yǒu is used in expressing the distance between two points.

Shànghǎi | lí | Nánjīng | yǒu | duō yuǎn?
(Shànghǎi | be separated from | Nánjīng | there is | how much distance?)
"How far is Shànghǎi from Nánjīng?"

Tiānjīn | lí | Běijīng | yǒu | yìbǎi'èrshí gōnglǐ.
(Tiānjīn | be separated from | Běijīng | there is | 120 kilometers.)
"Tiānjīn is 120 kilometers from Běijīng."

Liǎngbǎiwǔshiduō gōnglǐ: Approximate numbers may be expressed by adding -duō to number phrases. When added immediately after a number, before the counter, -duō refers to an indefinite amount within the range of the round number. (Gōnglǐ is one of the nouns used without a counter.)

liǎngbǎiduō gōnglǐ               more than 200 kilometers (but
                                 fewer than 300)
yìqiānduōge xuésheng             more than 1,000 students (but
                                 fewer than 2,000)
sānshiduōkuài qián               more than 30 dollars (but fewer
                                 than 40)

Beginning with 20, -duō may be used in this way with any round number. With round numbers from 20 through 90, -jǐ may be used instead of -duō.

èrshiduōge rén                   more than 20 persons (but fewer
èrshijǐge rén                    than 30)
sìshiduō gōnglǐ                  more than 40 kilometers (but
sìshijǐ gōnglǐ                   fewer than 50)

With the number 10, only -jǐ is used, never -duō.

shíjǐkuài qián                   more than 10 dollars (but fewer
                                 than 20)
